subject: general
question: Which of the following states is NOT located in the Indian Himalayan region?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bihar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Bihar** is not geographically located in the Indian Himalayan region.
 
• The Indian Himalayan Region (IHR) spans across 13 Indian states, including Jammu & Kashmir, Himachal Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Sikkim, and Arunachal Pradesh, among others.
 
• States like Uttarakhand and Sikkim are part of the IHR, known for their mountainous terrain and significant Himalayan ranges.
 
• Mizoram, although hilly, is part of the northeastern hill region and not the Indian Himalayan Region.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indian Himalayan Region (IHR)**

 
 
• It extends across 13 Indian states and union territories from Jammu & Kashmir in the west to Arunachal Pradesh in the east.
 
• The region plays a crucial role in influencing the climate, hydrology, and ecology of the Indian subcontinent.
 
• The IHR is home to diverse flora and fauna, many of which are endemic to the region.
 
• It is a major source of rivers like the Ganges, Brahmaputra, and Indus, which are vital for the water supply in India.
 
 
 
• **Bihar**
 
 
• Located in the eastern part of India, Bihar is known for its rich history and cultural heritage.
 
• The state is predominantly a plain region, lying in the Gangetic plains.
 
• Bihar experiences a tropical monsoon climate, unlike the cold climate of the Himalayan region.
 
• It is an important agricultural state, with major crops including rice, wheat, and sugarcane.
 
 
 
• **Uttarakhand**
 
 
• Also known as the "Land of the Gods" due to its numerous Hindu pilgrimage sites.
 
• Located in the northern part of India, it is home to the Garhwal and Kumaon Himalayan ranges.
 
• Uttarakhand has a significant portion of its area covered by forests and is known for its biodiversity.
 
• Popular hill stations like Nainital, Mussoorie, and pilgrimage sites like Kedarnath, Badrinath are located here.
 
 
 
• **Sikkim**
 
 
• A small northeastern Indian state bordered by Bhutan, Tibet, and Nepal.
 
• It is famous for its mountainous terrain, including the Kanchenjunga, the third highest peak in the world.
 
• Sikkim is known for its biodiversity, including alpine and subtropical climates.
 
• It is the first fully organic state in India, with all farming practices being organic.
